ipeds.title: College Navigator - Houston Christian University (IPEDS, fall 2024 admissions)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (fall 2025 entering class). Applicants = men 4,428 + women 7,337 + unknown 3 (the Common Data Set's total cell was left at 0); admitted 10,174 (86.5%); enrolled 1,001. Admits by residency: Texas 8,951, other states 926, international 165, unknown 132. International enrolled first-years: 43. International applicants were not reported, so no international admit rate is shown. College Navigator shows 8,455 applicants / 84% admitted for fall 2024. 254 enrollees (25.37%) sent SAT scores and 41 (4.10%) sent ACT scores. For GPA, 93.31% reported, average 3.43. Undergraduate enrollment (3,277) and nonresident count (143) are the 'Total Undergraduates' figures (all students, including part-time and non-degree). Student-faculty ratio 17:1 (3,742 students, 215 faculty).

cds_test_policy.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2027): SAT/ACT not required for admission but considered if submitted. It also says: 'Freshmen applicants will have the option of applying with test scores or applying as "test optional" and not including scores.'

cost.notes: From the Common Data Set (2026-27, residential): tuition $42,050; required fees $2,680; housing $9,072 + meals $4,570 = $13,642; books $1,330; transportation $1,919 + other $2,802 = $4,721. The total cost of attendance is the sum of those components (not a printed total). The Common Data Set marks the college's own need-based and non-need-based aid as both available to nonresidents; 113 degree-seeking nonresidents received it, average $31,106, total $3,514,978
